widget_mechanic: After applying ≥2 filters, an active-chip bar shows what is currently applied. Agent must verify each required chip is present (and no extras) before treating the result set as the answer.

source_inspiration.instruction: Find the cheapest used 8-cylinder BMW made between 2005-2015 and priced from 25,000 to 50,000.
source_inspiration.first_failure_summary: [1.4] Wrong values or constraint violation: Agent narrowed by make/price but never confirmed the 8-cylinder filter chip was present and removable from the applied-filter rail before reporting the cheapest result.
